sql.value: select ab.id, ab.name, ab.description, ab.template_a_id, ta.name as template_a_name, ab.template_a_version, ab.template_b_id, tb.name as template_b_name, ab.template_b_version, ab.model_id, m.model_name as model_name, ab.traffic_split, ab.status, ab.create_by, ab.create_time, ab.update_by, ab.update_time from ai_prompt_ab_test ab left join ai_prompt_template ta on ta.id = ab.template_a_id left join ai_prompt_template tb on tb.id = ab.template_b_id left join ai_model m on m.id = ab.model_id where ab.is_deleted=0 #[and ab.name like :name] #[and ab.status = :status] order by ab.id desc
select variant, count(1) as sample_count, avg(rating) as avg_rating from ai_prompt_eval where ab_test_id = :abTestId and variant is not null group by variant
